basic_info.description: Welcome to 90 Arago Street, a stunning Art Moderne gem perched in one of San Francisco's most beloved neighborhoods: Mission Terrace. With an expansive, unobstructed view of the iconic Balboa Park, this richly detailed and light-filled residence blends timeless architectural style with the ease and comfort of modern living. This well-maintained, move-in-ready home has undergone extensive upgrades, including a new roof, skylights, stylish terrazzo stairs, a high-efficiency water heater, copper plumbing, new flooring, and fresh exterior paint. The main level features a spacious living room, bright dining room, and a well-laid out kitchen, as well as two bedrooms and a bathroom. The lower level provides access to a private outdoor patio and a spacious primary suite. Across the street, 25 acres of Balboa Park is your playground. The park features a dedicated dog-friendly area, providing an opportunity to mingle and connect with your neighbors. Balboa Park boasts an Olympic-sized swimming pool, 4 newly resurfaced tennis courts, playground, skatepark, well-maintained baseball and soccer fields, and brand-new basketball courts. The location is a commuter's dream, with proximity to BART, Muni, and freeways. Beyond the home itself, you'll find a true sense of community.
